verdict.rationale: A note-taking and knowledge-management SaaS could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, a TypeScript SDK (npm install @capacities/api), an MCP server and AI chat connectors, but nothing describes an official command-line tool. The SDK and API are developer building blocks, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
